**Inside this commit (parts.tsx lines 130-176):**
- **(f) Missing "tool call" text.** The `receipt` array is empty when `durationMs` and `cost` are both absent, so the right side shows nothing. Spec lines 1311 and 1323 show "tool call" for `save` and `record`.
- **(g) Money format.** `money()` uses `toFixed(4)`, so the demo's `SEARCH_COST` of 0.01 shows as "$0.0100". The spec shows "$0.01". `money()` is older than this commit, but this commit adds the per-step use.
- **(g) Zero cost.** `detail?.cost ?` tests the object, so a cost of `{dollars: 0}` would draw "$0.0000". The demo worker never sends a zero cost, so only a real worker can reach this case.
- **(i) Search query wrap.** The row text span has `min-w-0 flex-1` and no `truncate`. The spec shows one line with an ellipsis.

**Correct, but older than this commit (from #27):**
- **(b) Breadcrumb.** The header in `Session.tsx` lines 156-162 never names the open child task. The spec script at line 1772 appends "/ <name>".
- **(c) Scroll area.** The Card at `Session.tsx` line 178 has `min-h-96` and no overflow. Spec CSS lines 331-333 make the stream a scroll area with the composer bar fixed below it.
- **(d) THINKING and REPLY.** Thinking has no background. Reply uses `text-keep` and has no left border. Spec CSS lines 481-485 give thinking `var(--ground)` and reply `3px solid var(--ink)` with an ink label.
- **(e) Child task label.** parts.tsx line 87 writes "to <agent>". Spec line 1346 writes "task".
- **(h) DELEGATED chip.** parts.tsx line 183 draws a plain Eyebrow. Spec line 1300 draws `ui-status busy`.

**(a) Stop button: correct, but not this branch's work.** `session.stop` is in the contract at `events.ts` line 36, and `routes.ts` line 77 sends it to `kernel.stop`. The composer belongs to LI ZHUOYANG: `docs/SLICES.md` UC4 line 43 and the comment at parts.tsx lines 285-289 defer steering a running task to the steering slice. Treat (a) as a note for that owner.

Severity: should-fix fits (f), (g) and (i), because this commit's purpose is to draw the step receipt as the spec shows it. Each of the other items is a nit. Nothing here breaks function, data, or a repo rule.
